importPolicy.workspaceRequiresExplicitOptIn: workspace/AGENTS.md; never replace the Web development AGENTS.md implicitly
importPolicy.packageActivation: Writing package declarations can trigger installation on the next Pi start. Only opt-in --with-extensions may configure them; copying is not activation or availability proof.
importPolicy.disabledFilters: Preserve empty package filter arrays and negative extension entries; do not expand them into defaults.

requires: 工具/hy-memory迁移 adapter and separately configured Hy-Memory service
user-owned configuration/token; no memory/token/model payload included
optionalEnvironments.defaultAction: Do not start a service or scan/import existing memories

requires: user-selected Chrome/backend and matching computer-use host
OpenCLI + Browser Bridge for authenticated OpenCLI tasks
separate Playwright MCP localhost:8931 only if configured
optionalEnvironments.defaultAction: No browser/profile/login/service is opened by import

requires: separately installed language servers for selected languages
tmux and compatible shell/PTY for background terminals
macOS launchd/Homebrew paths only for optional pi-web-service and maintenance wrappers
macOS Keychain + already authorized agent-browser for password-fill
optional Herdr socket/pane environment for herdr-agent-state
optionalEnvironments.defaultAction: Do not read Keychain, enumerate accounts, register launchd, or activate platform-specific helpers
Do not run archive_health.py with its author-specific default; no archive/index/session data is shipped

requires: user-provided BRAVE_API_KEY if Brave search is selected
explicit user proxy configuration before proxy-env use
separately installed TeX tools/fonts for latex-homework
optionalEnvironments.defaultAction: Do not import .api-key, proxy rules.yaml, install tools, or enable the author's proxy

hostCompatibility: Seven roles rely on the customized pi-subagents host for advertised roles, nested tools and inheritance/fork settings.
Empty upstream pi-subagents/background-task extension filters remain empty; settings explicitly register their local quiet adapters instead of source-machine symlinks.
Package installation or copying direct extension source does not prove terminal/Web discovery, reload, model response or external-service readiness.
